dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: Sorter, can you decipher the vinyl record?
Sorter swiftly looks over the vinyl for analysis. A tune plays from Sorter's speakers.

dialogue.name: SORTER
dialogue.text: It's music. The humans sent us music?

dialogue.name: LIFTER
dialogue.text: I mean, this doesn't seem too hard. Just, like, keep things on beat, yeah?

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: Hm. Lifter, make a holo-copy of yourself. Once you're done, everybody set up and start feeling the music!
